title: Claude Enterprise plan | Claude by Anthropic

facts.fact: Claude Enterprise is priced at $20 per seat per month, billed annually, with usage billed as you go at API rates.
facts.quote:
$20

Per seat / month, billed annually.  
Usage is billed as you go at API rates, based on what your team uses.

facts.fact: Claude Enterprise requires an annual commitment and a minimum of 20 seats.
facts.quote: Annual commitment required. Minimum 20 seats.

facts.fact: Prices shown on the Claude Enterprise page do not include applicable tax, and prices and plans are subject to change at Anthropic's discretion.
facts.quote: Prices shown don’t include applicable tax. Price and plans are subject to change at Anthropic's discretion.

facts.fact: Anthropic states that prompts, data, and results are not used to train its models by default.
facts.quote: Your prompts, data, and results are not used to train our models by default.

facts.fact: Data retention controls and OTEL monitoring are currently available on Claude Enterprise only.
facts.quote: Data retention controls and OTEL monitoring are currently available on Claude Enterprise only.

facts.fact: According to a customer testimonial, a software company saw 12 hours of prototyping work collapse into about 20 minutes, a vendor-reported 97% reduction in prototyping time.
facts.quote: 97%reduction in prototyping time

facts.fact: A life sciences customer reports clinical study documentation reduced from 10 weeks to 10 minutes using Claude Code (vendor-cited 1000x).
facts.quote: 1000x clinical study documentation down from 10 weeks to 10 minutes

facts.fact: Slack reports a 97 minutes per week saving per average user through summarization and recap features, as cited on the Anthropic page.
facts.quote: 97 minutes per week saved by the average user through summarization and recap features

facts.fact: Allianz is cited as seeing 90% week-over-week growth in company-wide deployment.
facts.quote: 90%week-over-week growth company-wide deployment, with rapid global adoption

facts.fact: A transportation customer reports an 87% reduction in customer support time using Claude.
facts.quote: 87%reduction in customer support time

facts.fact: A transportation customer reports a 30% increase in more accurate teams making sharper calls.
facts.quote: 30%more accurate teams making sharper calls

facts.fact: Moody's cites credit memo prep time cut from 40 hours to 2 minutes with Claude-built agents (vendor-cited 1,200x faster).
facts.quote: 1,200× faster credit memo prep time cut from 40 hours to 2 minutes with Claude-built agents

facts.fact: A software customer reports 30+ concurrent agent tasks from a single task board using Claude Managed Agents.
facts.quote: 30+concurrent agent tasks from a single task board

facts.fact: Anthropic's Claude Code results page reports that Spotify saw a 90% reduction in time spent on complex code migrations.
facts.quote: less time spent on complex code migrations

facts.fact: Anthropic states that customer inputs and outputs are not used to train its models by default.
facts.quote: Your inputs and outputs are not used to train our models by default.

facts.fact: Claude Enterprise data controls include custom data retention, customer-managed encryption keys, and US-only inference.
facts.quote: custom data retention, customer-managed encryption keys, and US-only inference.

facts.fact: Claude Enterprise includes IP allowlisting and network-level access control, which prevents access to personal or non-corporate Claude instances from enterprise networks.
facts.quote: IP allowlisting and network-level access control, which prevents access to personal or non-corporate Claude instances from enterprise networks.

facts.fact: Anthropic's Claude Enterprise page lists SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, and CCPA compliance among its security features.
facts.quote: SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, and CCPA compliance

facts.fact: Anthropic lists a HIPAA-ready offering as a Claude Enterprise feature.
facts.quote: HIPAA-ready offering

facts.fact: Claude Enterprise connector governance lets admins approve which connectors are available org-wide and set per-tool permissions, and connectors respect the permissions users already have in underlying systems.
facts.quote: Connectors respect the permissions users already have in the underlying systems.

facts.fact: Claude Platform's self-serve API access uses pay-as-you-go pricing with usage-based tiers and automatically increasing rate limits.
facts.quote: Pay-as-you-go pricing

facts.fact: Claude Platform's self-serve tier includes access to all Claude models.
facts.quote: Access to all Claude models

facts.fact: Anthropic's sales-assisted Claude Platform support offers custom rate limits, Anthropic-supported onboarding, and billing via monthly invoices.
facts.quote: Billing via monthly invoices

facts.fact: Claude Enterprise's Compliance API provides programmatic access to activity logs, chats, files, and projects.
facts.quote: a Compliance API for programmatic access to activity logs, chats, files, and projects

facts.fact: Admins of Claude Enterprise can define groups, roles, and capabilities to govern which people can use which products and connectors, using role-based access control.
facts.quote: Admins define groups, roles, and capabilities to govern exactly which people can use which products and connectors.

facts.fact: Claude Enterprise is positioned to give every employee secure access to Chat, Claude Cowork, Claude Code, and company connectors.
facts.quote: Give every employee secure access to Chat, Claude Cowork, Claude Code, and your company's connectors.

facts.fact: Claude Enterprise includes a HIPAA-ready configuration available with a BAA from Anthropic, after which the organization can process PHI through Claude in accordance with HIPAA.
facts.quote: HIPAA-ready configuration is available with a BAA from Anthropic. Once enabled, your organization can process Protected Health Information (PHI) through Claude in accordance with HIPAA.

facts.fact: Healthcare customers on the Claude Platform can sign a BAA with no Zero Data Retention requirement.
facts.quote: Healthcare customers can sign a BAA with no Zero Data Retention requirement.

facts.fact: Claude Enterprise is available directly from Anthropic and through AWS Marketplace, where it can draw down from an existing AWS commit.
facts.quote: Claude Enterprise is available directly from Anthropic and through AWS Marketplace, where it can draw down from your existing AWS commit.

facts.fact: Sales-assisted Claude Enterprise plans include invoice billing, while self-serve Enterprise plans accept credit card or ACH bank transfer.
facts.quote: Sales-assisted Claude Enterprise plans include invoice billing. Self-serve Enterprise plans accept credit card or ACH bank transfer.

facts.fact: Self-serve Claude Platform accounts are prepaid, requiring a payment method and purchased credits, with optional auto-reload; Enterprise customers can use monthly invoicing instead.
facts.quote: Self-serve accounts are prepaid: add a payment method, purchase credits, and optionally enable auto-reload.

facts.fact: Credits on the Claude Platform cover API usage, the Workbench, and Claude Code when authenticated with an API key.
facts.quote: Credits cover API usage, the Workbench, and Claude Code (when authenticated with an API key).

facts.fact: All three of Chat, Claude Code, and Claude Cowork are included in every Enterprise plan.
facts.quote: All three are included in every Enterprise plan and entitlements are managed with role-based access controls from organization settings.

facts.fact: Claude Enterprise's one seat gives every employee access to Chat, Claude Code, Claude Cowork, Claude Design, and Claude in tools such as Microsoft 365, Chrome, and Slack.
facts.quote: One seat gives every employee the full suite: Chat for everyday thinking work, Claude Code for engineering, Claude Cowork for delegating multi-step knowledge work, Claude Design

facts.fact: Claude for Work was the earlier name for Anthropic's business plans, now Team and Enterprise; the name has been retired.
facts.quote: Claude for Work was the earlier name for our business plans — what are now the Team and Enterprise plans. The name has been retired

facts.fact: Claude Enterprise security and administration features include SSO, SCIM and JIT provisioning, role-based access control, audit logs, Compliance API, Analytics API, custom data retention, customer-managed encryption keys, IP allowlisting, and network-level access control.
facts.quote: Single sign-on (SSO), domain capture, SCIM and JIT provisioning

facts.fact: Claude Platform supports Amazon Bedrock, Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, and Microsoft Foundry as availability channels for the API.
facts.quote: Claude Platform (the API) is also available on Amazon Bedrock, Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, and Microsoft Foundry.
